summary: Updates a line item of a shipment.
description:
This method applies partial updates to a line item within a shipment. The request body should
            specify only the fields  to be updated. If the operation is successful, the updated line item details are
            returned.

parameters.name: shipment_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the shipment containing the line item to be updated. Must not be an empty GUID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the line item to be updated. Must not be an empty GUID.

schema.description: Class representing a procore response with data.
Represents a request to update specific properties of a shipment line.

quantity.description: The quantity to update for the shipment line. Specify null to leave the quantity unchanged.

date.description:
The date and time to update for the shipment line. Specify null to leave the date and time
            unchanged.
